title: SSC Delhi Police Driver PE & MT Date 2026
postName: Constable (Driver) Male in Delhi Police Examination 2025 – PE&MT / DV / Trade Test
vacancyDetails: 660 revised vacancies for Constable (Driver) Male in Delhi Police Examination 2025.
qualification: 10+2 (Senior Secondary) pass and valid Heavy Motor Driving Licence as prescribed in the official SSC notification.
ageLimit: 21 to 30 years as prescribed in the official examination notification, with applicable relaxations.
applicationFee: ₹100; women candidates and candidates belonging to SC, ST and eligible Ex-Servicemen categories are exempted as per SSC rules.
selectionProcess: Computer Based Examination → PE&MT / Document Verification → Trade Test → Final Selection
documentsRequired: PE&MT/DV admission certificate, valid original photo ID, original educational/eligibility documents and valid driving licence as required by Delhi Police.
howToApply:
1. Visit https://delhipolice.gov.in/recruitments
2. Open the recruitment notice for Constable (Driver) in Delhi Police Examination 2025
3. Check the latest revised PE&MT schedule
4. Download the PE&MT/DV admission certificate when available
5. Verify venue, date and reporting time
6. Appear with the required original documents
shortDescription: SSC Delhi Police Driver PE&MT 2026 revised schedule has been released by Delhi Police. Candidates should check the latest PE&MT schedule and admission certificate on delhipolice.gov.in.
content:
Staff Selection Commission (SSC) conducted the Computer Based Examination for Constable (Driver) Male in Delhi Police Examination 2025 on 16 and 17 December 2025. Candidates qualifying the CBE were shortlisted for PE&MT / Document Verification / Trade Test.

The SSC result notice dated 29 April 2026 states that the PE&MT/DV will be conducted by Delhi Police and that its schedule and admission certificates will be communicated by Delhi Police.

Delhi Police subsequently issued notices regarding the PE&MT schedule, postponements and a revised schedule dated 03 September 2026. Candidates should follow the latest Delhi Police recruitment notice because earlier PE&MT dates were revised/postponed.

importantDates.examDate: PE&MT – Revised schedule issued on 03 September 2026
importantDates.admitCardDate: PE&MT/DV admission certificate issued by Delhi Police as per schedule
